findings.title: The validated component graph still describes V3.1 and does not bind the V3.2 policy or sidecar code
evidence: V3.2 delegates base validation to the frozen V3.1 policy and accepts the V3.1 exact artifact graph.
That graph contains policy_v3_1 and its tests but no policy_v3_2, V3.2 sidecar schema, or V3.2 tests.
The V3.2 result decorates the base result but does not require a component-lock node or loaded-byte hash for the running V3.2 module.
The external draft-review freeze binds V3.2 file hashes, but it is explicitly not a component lock or reviewed release.
findings.counterevidence: The frozen review envelope prevents silent mutation during this draft review and every result remains machine-only and canonical-execution-blocked.
findings.adjudication: V3.2 may be reviewed as a deterministic draft wrapper, but it cannot qualify a component generation or production loader until a new exact acyclic graph includes and verifies the V3.2 artifacts themselves.
findings.required_repair: Create a newly named exact V3.2 component-graph schema whose nodes include the V3.2 policy, tests, sidecar contract, collector, checker, wrapper, kernel, primitive, loader, and launcher. Bind loaded bytes through a separately reviewed sealed loader without a self-hash cycle.

findings.title: Parent chains are same-volume identity lists, not closed handle-rooted parent-child relations
evidence: Each nonroot parent chain contains only identities_from_model plus the logical path-token depth.

The policy checks the terminal identity, depth, volume, and global uniqueness but has no per-hop leaf name, parent identity, child identity, retained-handle relation, or collector attestation bound to the chain.
An internally consistent list of unrelated same-volume directory identities with the right length and terminal identity can satisfy the pure relation.
findings.counterevidence: The V3.2 policy closes cross-volume and identity-alias attacks that V3.1 accepted, and the test-only native helper retains real handle-rooted directories in its disposable fixture.
findings.adjudication: The policy improvement is real but does not yet encode the native handle-root evidence required for a production component.
findings.required_repair: Represent every hop as a closed parent_identity plus exact leaf_component plus child_identity relation with retained-handle/root-relative-open evidence and one observation digest; require the ordered chain to start at model_identity and terminate at the frozen parent identity.

findings.title: Lease origin and observation attestations remain caller-described until a separate sealed collector and wrapper exist
evidence: The policy validates lease ID syntax, same-ID continuity, boot, deadlines, and dual-clock skew.
It cannot verify that the lease ID came from an opaque nonserializable wrapper object or that observation attestations came from retained production handles.
The frozen draft correctly reports no production collector, wrapper, reviewed release, execution freeze, or external owner capability.
findings.counterevidence: All supplied relations are closed and hash-bound, and authority fields remain false.
findings.adjudication: Expected for a pure-policy draft; keep as a mandatory later integration gate, not a reason to claim current fraud.
findings.required_repair: Only a separately named, independently reviewed collector/wrapper/loader generation can close origin and loaded-byte provenance.

positive_closure_observed: full system rows are supplied and bounded candidates are derived inside policy
enumeration API terminal status count and digests are checked
all digest subjects receive checker-interval attestations
same lease ID boot whole-lease duration interphase order and dual-clock skew are enforced
strict numeric recursion rejects floats booleans negatives and overflow in numeric fields
canonical continuity SHA-256 equality is enforced across prepare and publish
native lease registration and arbitrary retention are no longer exposed
exact root sentinels use the retained model handle in disposable tests
fixed validator file entry point has no caller path parameters
all outputs remain candidate-only and non-authorizing

preserved_dissent.reason: Complete bounded enumeration and relational identity checks still cannot exclude hidden, renamed, pre-opened, future, kernel, sync, or noncooperating writers.

next_action: Collect both fresh blind V3.2 peer reports, then obtain a separate boss ruling over those reports and this root challenge. Preserve V3.2 append-only if either critical finding is sustained.
